comparison.objective: Align mating pipe flanges and insert locating pins through corresponding holes.
comparison.physical_skill: Coaxial flange support, rotational hole alignment and precision pin insertion; candidate requires agitation-driven reorientation and selective passage of many loose bodies.
comparison.success_condition: Flanges aligned within millimetre/angular tolerances and pins seated in distinct holes; versions differ between four vertical pins and two horizontal pins. Candidate success is separation yield, retention, reseating and dwell. Release requirements are absent in some flange versions but this does not create plausible duplication.
comparison.reason: This is the closest record in generic bimanual support/alignment, yet its tested ability is mating-part registration and insertion, not physical classification through apertures.
